name: Grouped checkboxes
description: A form widget that groups checkboxes by their parent (e.g. terms by vocabulary).
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Provides a widget for term-reference fields that groups terms from multiple vocabularies into collapsible details elements

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Terms are nicely grouped into vocabularies 
 Vocabularies with no items selected remain collapsed by default 
 That's it 🧘 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation/Configuration 
 
 Add an entity reference field and configure the target entity-type to be Taxonomy terms 
 Configure the allowed vocabularies as usual 
 Head to manage form display, and change the widget to 'Grouped checkboxes/Radios' 
 If your field is multi-value, it will use checkboxes, otherwise it will use radios. 
 
 Back to top
